title: TransferIssue
description: A classified transformation, validation or parity outcome requiring scoped review.

id.description: Immutable identity allocated once by the interoperability owner.

job_id.x-reference-scope: Reference must resolve inside the owning Institution or the directly owned aggregate.

plan_revision.description: Exact plan for typed issue evidence. Absent only for pre-plan artifact diagnostics.

record_id.x-reference-scope: Reference must resolve inside the owning Institution or the directly owned aggregate.

issue_key.description: Stable evidence digest used to deduplicate retries.

state.description: Authoritative lifecycle state advanced only through owner commands.

reviewer_principal_id.x-reference-scope: Reference must resolve inside the owning Institution or the directly owned aggregate.

revision.description: Monotonic aggregate revision used for compare-and-swap.

x-invariants: Blocking scoring loss cannot become an accepted difference without a verified replacement that changes the issue classification.
Safe summaries exclude responses, tokens and unredacted scripts.
A typed record or edge issue refers to the same job and plan revision. Keep superseded issues with original reviewed plan evidence.
